name: Ouch / Trip · Director Pass 1
coordinates: glTF right-handed Y-up; local bone position, quaternion XYZW and scale; Babylon scene.useRightHandedSystem=true
limitations: glTF uses linear blend skinning; native Blender uses dual-quaternion skinning with a local shoulder blend.
Browser clay is a simple rough PBR material; the native procedural fingerprint surface is not baked into this preview.
Morph targets carry positions; the browser retains skinned base normals while soft-end shapes change.
Only the character and rig are shipped. Holding poses retain the arm gesture but their draft props are not included.
Native pose-dependent drivers are sampled into exported clips; free browser posing does not evaluate Blender drivers.
